extracted.name: Submarine Flavors
extracted.description: Flavored oil for Italian submarine sandwiches.
instruction_lines: Combine all ingredients in a jar, and let sit for at least an hour to steep the flavors in the oil. Sprinkle generously on the lettuce in your sub or directly on the insides of the bun.
